VHP Bans Muslims from Navratri Events in Maharashtra

The Vishva Hindu Parishad (VHP) has prohibited Muslims from participating in Garba and Dandiya events across Maharashtra. The organization has also set rules for event organizers. The ban applies to Navratri celebrations.
